info.title: CommercialKonnect Mission Control API
info.description: Business discovery via a scoped Windows CLI worker, funding enquiry intake, human qualification and opportunity review. A reviewed implementation slice, not a claim of live deployment.

ApiToken.description: Scoped ck_ID.secret token. Store only its SHA-256 digest in server configuration.

ClerkSession.name: __session
ClerkSession.description: Verified Clerk session with an active organization. Browser writes require the same Origin.
